therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: suppression of inflammatory cytokine release and immune-mediated joint inflammation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with rheumatoid arthritis on stable low-dose prednisone (3–10 mg/day)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Relative change from baseline in duration of morning stiffness at Week 12

results.effect_size: MR Prednisone: -22.7% vs IR Prednisone: -0.4% relative change in morning stiffness duration
biomarker_changes: DAS28 relative change at Week 12: MR Prednisone -9.03% (95% CI: -11.9 to -6.2); IR Prednisone -12.30% (95% CI: -15.2 to -9.4)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events: MR Prednisone 4/144 (2.8%); IR Prednisone 3/144 (2.1%)

dose_info.schedule: once daily (MR at bedtime; IR in the morning)

context.comparator: IR Prednisone (immediate-release, taken in the morning)
